headline: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑今日热搜
headlineEn: Spider-Man: New Day Tops Today's Trending
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周6部新片。《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》、《恶魔之口》等持续热映。国际新片《오케이 마담 2》、《逃出绝命街》即将登场。
summaryEn: No new releases today, 6 new films this week. Spider-Man: New Day, Demon's Mouth, etc. continue hot. Upcoming international releases: OK Madame 2, Escape from Desperate Street.
